cause: after the question was approved and the first ideas filed

4-time-each-stage-of-duplicate-detection.line: Every other idea needs its baseline times and reference groups, so it goes first.

why.impact: It shows which stage dominates, which decides which speed-up is worth having.
why.odds: It is a measurement and can hardly fail to produce one.
why.path: Ideas 5 to 8 are each judged against its timings and its saved duplicate groups.

5-find-likeness-candidates-with-a-gpu-ne.line: The likeness sweep is the near-quadratic CPU stage, and a blocked GPU search already exists in the code to reuse.

why.impact: If the sweep dominates, replacing a near-quadratic CPU pass with a sub-second GPU one is the largest possible gain.
why.odds: The arithmetic is small for a GPU and utils/near_neighbor.py already does the same search for tags.
why.path: It waits for idea 4's baseline and reference groups.

6-decode-pictures-at-reduced-size-for-th.line: The code says CPU decode is 4 of 4.2 seconds per embedding batch, but the gain depends on how many files are JPEG.

why.impact: It speeds up the first stage every new picture goes through, though only for formats that decode at reduced size.
why.odds: Draft-mode decoding is well established for JPEG, but PNG and other formats gain little and embeddings may shift slightly.
why.path: It waits for idea 4's baseline and its file-type mix.

8-replace-the-scan-s-buckets-with-a-libr.line: Tier 2 is already reported as milliseconds per bucket, so this is more likely to win on found groups than on time.

why.impact: It could remove the per-bucket caps and catch pairs the buckets never compare, but tier 2 is probably not where the time goes.
why.odds: Multi-index hashing is standard, but beating an already fast bucketed comparison on time is uncertain.
why.path: It waits for idea 4's tier-2 timing and reference groups.

7-stop-the-likeness-parameters-stage-fro.line: It only helps if parameters are often recomputed for unchanged pictures, which nothing shows yet.

why.impact: It saves repeated sweep work only after a recomputation, not on a first import.
why.odds: How often unchanged pictures are recomputed is unknown and may be rare.
why.path: It waits for idea 4, whose run counts how many recomputed pictures actually change.
